arStrings.szText: Casted {c_important}Ice Shards{/c} now spreads out with {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} additional shards. You deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|1x%|]{/c} increased damage for each time {c_important}Ice Shards{/c} damages an enemy for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds, up to {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100*Affix."Static Value 1"|1x%|]{/c}.

Casted {c_important}Ice Shards{/c} now spreads out with {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} additional shards. You deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|1x%|]{/c} increased damage for each time {c_important}Ice Shards{/c} damages an enemy for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds, up to {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100*Affix."Static Value 1"|1x%|]{/c}.
